name: Senses
description:
The First Audio-Visual Generative Poetic collection on the blockchain.

Senses is a healing audio-visual poetic journey through the mind-body and spirit that is based on 100 original poems written/performed by David Bianchi inspired by the five human senses.

Each piece incorporates generative psychedelic art by Dogan Demir coded from data from David's poetic recordings, as well as healing Solfeggio frequency music by EDM producer 
PLS&TY .

The owner of each piece will hold the commercial re-sale and publishing rights to David's poetry as well as access to metaverse immersive sound baths and IRL experiences in major markets.

legendaryEditions.name: Sight LGD #1
legendaryEditions.description:
The phenomenon of sight is our key to the world.
It’s the way we interpret everything we know.
The moon will rise and fall
The sun will glow at set
Thank you, my gift of sight these marvels, I’ll never forget.

legendaryEditions.name: Sight LGD #2
legendaryEditions.description:
They say that beauty is in the eye of the beholder.
Beauty is subjective and it often makes me wonder,
What is it about sight that changes point of view?
There’s definitely some societal programming in there too.
But the eye sees and the heart wanders,
Truly touching,
How sight makes the heart grow fonder.

legendaryEditions.name: Sight LGD #3
legendaryEditions.description:
The size of our pupils are controlled by the iris
With muscles so tiny their borderline microscopic
They’ll open or constrict depending how much light is around
The beauty of it all
Sunlight
To Sundown

legendaryEditions.name: Sight LGD #4
legendaryEditions.description:
The color of our eyes is dictated by melanin
The same principles that control the color of our skin
Fascinating how we all see the same through the magic iris
But the same principles that create the magic of eye color
Sadly divide us,
Maybe someday we’ll see details within?
The color of the beauty of our eyes,
Matches the beauty,
Of our skin.

legendaryEditions.name: Sight LGD #5
legendaryEditions.description:
There is much to be seen between you and me.
Colors, textures and the shape of things.
But what about energy?
An important question in a subjective reality,
Because one would argue,
Even a blind man,
Can see.

legendaryEditions.name: Sight LGD #6
legendaryEditions.description:
Most of us can see up to one million shades of color.

Some 100 million - an anatomical wonder-
They say our eyes are most sensitive to bright green.

I tend to enjoy a cool shade of blue.
What’s so special about your favorite color,
Is it’s yours,
And only yours,
And particular,
To you.

legendaryEditions.name: Sight LGD #7
legendaryEditions.description:
Sometimes I want to have vision,
Sometimes I want to see,
Sometimes I want to be visual,
Sometimes I want to be seen.
My eyes tell what’s real,
My heart tells me the truth.
But there is something about a lie,
That people can always see through.

legendaryEditions.name: Senses LGD #8
legendaryEditions.description:
The soul is an open book if you look one in the eyes,
But gaining the trust of one for that time is harder to find,
Simply glancing is not looking,
And looking is not seeing,
Who loves you enough?
To allow you close enough,
To truly read their meaning?

legendaryEditions.name: Sight LGD #9
legendaryEditions.description:
The next time you see a pretty color,
Pause and reflect on yet another.
Tap into the feeling that the color emits,
Remember a moment associated with it.
Escape for a while and let the feeling free,
Fill your heart with gratitude,
And your ability to see.

legendaryEditions.name: Sight LGD #10
legendaryEditions.description:
Most of the time man gets in the way,
Of being able to see gifts on a sun shiny day,
Smog and smoke block our view --
Otherwise, we could see 20km through
Without the smog,
At sea it’s the curvature that blocks the view of the earth,
But we all love a beach sunset,
For whatever it’s worth.

legendaryEditions.name: Smell LGD #1
legendaryEditions.description:
Perfumes are made from the finest ingredients.
Flowers and oils that create a magical experience,
A way to escape,
A way to cast a spell,
A way to make the opposite sex feel love and overwhelmed.
A way to create allure and sultry mystery,
An alchemic mix of sexuality and chemistry.

legendaryEditions.name: Smell LGD #2
legendaryEditions.description:
Oil slicks,
Landfills,
Turpentine,
Burnt grease.
Burned rubber,
Melting plastic,
Tear gas,
Factories,
There is nothing comfortable about the smell these create,
It’s time we re-think the damage we really make.

legendaryEditions.name: Smell LGD #3
legendaryEditions.description:
We can smell danger,
We can smell the holidays,
We can smell romance,
And love in the air ways.
We can smell comfort,
We can smell sex,
We can smell happiness,
And we can smell death,
Signals of life that smell helps us find,
Signals of humanity,
Memories painted on the mind.

legendaryEditions.name: Smell LGD #4
legendaryEditions.description:
The smell of herbs always makes me smile.
Parsley, sage, rosemary and thyme,
Aloe, mint, lavender mist,
Can take you to a place you’ve always loved and miss.
There is such a comfort in certain scents,
The fabric of our stories,
In olfactory language.

legendaryEditions.name: Smell LGD #5
legendaryEditions.description:
Some smells feel romantic,
Some remind you of danger,
Some place you in a resentment,
The festering of anger.
Some will make you feel confused,
Yet some remind you of home,
Some will wrap you up in love,
Even when you’re alone.

legendaryEditions.name: Smell LGD #6
legendaryEditions.description:
The mystery of the scent of a woman’s perfume,
Such a welcoming introduction as one walks in the room.
Knowing that someone smells so sweet,
It’s spell binding sometimes and makes men weak.
The power of a woman before she even speaks,
The strength of her aura,
Is bold,
Yet discreet.

legendaryEditions.name: Smell LGD #7
legendaryEditions.description:
I catch the scent of a memory,
I am quickly drawn back,
I catch the scent of that memory and mind quickly reacts.
I don’t recall the place,
Or even the time exact,
But I do remember how I felt,
The day that scent
Brought me back.

legendaryEditions.name: Smell LGD #8
legendaryEditions.description:
Breathe in deep,
Smell the air,
Take a big breath out,
Release it there.
Breathe in gently,
Is the smell still there?

legendaryEditions.name: Smell LGD #9
legendaryEditions.description:
The sweet smell of pine,
Awakens the imagination,
Gives us a piece of mother nature’s perfume.
The smell of Christmas,
A relaxing sigh,
A warm feeling in the winter,
Even when it’s cold outside.

legendaryEditions.name: Smell LGD #10
legendaryEditions.description:
Smell brings joy,
It can also bring pain.
It can bring you the memories of days gone,
And make you ponder on what remains.
It can awaken a thought that has left you for years,
The sweet smells of life,
I smother my pillow with the smell of her,
So when I’m alone,
I feel alright.

legendaryEditions.name: Sound LGD #1
legendaryEditions.description:
Sounds baths calm anxiety,
And deeply relax the mind,
Reduce stress,
Improve sleep,
And lower blood pressure at the same time.
But it takes a willingness,
A willingness to pause,
Pause long enough--
To receive the gift of it all.
Some sounds need stillness...
To actually heal,
The noise in the mind,
That is often is too real.

legendaryEditions.name: Sound LGD #2
legendaryEditions.description:
There is a place we all used to go long back when we were kids,
That secret hiding place where dragons and fairies lived.
Laughing papa bears,
And galloping unicorns,
Lions that told you bedtime stories.
And genies lived in a lamp.
We could hear them all so vividly
Way - back - then,
Now my quiet places are quiet,
Not full of joy and fantasy,
I sometimes wish my imagination,
Could bring those sounds back to me.

legendaryEditions.name: Sound LGD #3
legendaryEditions.description:
Sound can be intimate,
Sound can be aggressive,
It can be delicate,
It can be sensitive,
It can be hurtful,
It can be sweet,
There so many ways that we can describe
The sounds of the world,
One wave at a time.

legendaryEditions.name: Sound LGD #4
legendaryEditions.description:
Music Therapy,
The healing of sound.
A violin, A cello,
Hummingbirds in the background,
There is scientific proof that sound truly heals.
It can change the structure of water,
And calm an angry mind,
We should honor the gift of sound,
One note,
One chime,
One wood wind at a time.

legendaryEditions.name: Sound LGD #5
legendaryEditions.description:
Mechanically sound is just vibration in the air
It is present in all places, it is present everywhere
It changes based on the barriers it passes through.
Or the distance it must reach,
Be a gun shot or a speech,
Each has its characteristics vibrating in the air,
Inch by inch,
The vibration everywhere.

legendaryEditions.name: Sound LGD #6
legendaryEditions.description:
An Operatic voice,
Concerts that rock,
Hip Hop classics,
Harmonizing du-wop,
A Funky Jazz tune,
And pop music hits,
The scratch of fingernails on a mean guitar riff!
Let the classical music play,
Let the new music shine,
We sent it to outer space,
Because it’s the stamp of mankind.

legendaryEditions.name: Sound LGD #7
legendaryEditions.description:
Can you recollect the first thing you ever heard?
I know I can’t,
Was it an activity or a word?
Was it the sound of my mother’s beating heart?
I like to believe that.
That it was love from the start.
A gentle heart thump bu-bump bu-bump
That reminder of life,
Love in every pump.

legendaryEditions.name: Sound LGD #8
legendaryEditions.description:
If a tree falls in the forest, and no one is around to hear it,
Does it make a sound?
Can we be so arrogant to think it doesn’t if we’re not around?
We know a butterfly shakes the air even though you can’t hear it,
Do you hear the voice of God if you’re silent in your spirit?
The truth is sound is... all up to you
Your perception will always remind you...
Which sounds ring true.

legendaryEditions.name: Sound LGD #9
legendaryEditions.description:
Children laugh.
People play,
Puppies bark,
A song today,
A cricket chirps,
A crashing wave,
A mothers hum,
All in the airwaves.

legendaryEditions.name: Sound LGD #10
legendaryEditions.description:
Sounds can be familiar,
Comforting at ease.
Sounds can remind us of trauma,
Buried deep within our psyche.
Sounds can produce joy,
Sadness and grief.
Even the sound of silence can be loud,
If you listen deep.

legendaryEditions.name: Taste LGD #1
legendaryEditions.description:
The taste of drinking water is so elusive.
Some say it taste like nothing,
Yet it’s life-giving nectar.
Add sugar and call it a soft drink,
Add some salt and it disinfects.
Tea and the sunshine brings families together to laugh, hug, and reflect.
Add some lemon and its crisp.
Add cucumber and its refreshing.
That magic thing called water,
The elixir of everything.

legendaryEditions.name: Taste LGD #2
legendaryEditions.description:
Without the nose taste is incomplete.
Everything in the body is connected so intricately.
Every part so interdependent,
Taste relies on the nose.
The simple smell of food,
That makes taste,
Feel like home.

legendaryEditions.name: Taste LGD #3
legendaryEditions.description:
I love the funny faces people make,
When something in their mouth like a strange or awkward taste?
A sour taste that’s guaranteed to contort the face!
A putrid taste will make you spit it out in a haste.
A not so bad...But I can’t spit it out because people are around face?
That Mom I told you so I hate this flavor face!
Tell-tale signs of what’s happening on the tongue,
People don’t say a word,
And their faces come undone.

legendaryEditions.name: Taste LGD #4
legendaryEditions.description:
The taste of a lover is oh so sweet.
Often time that taste can live in your heart for weeks,
Wouldn’t you love to box it up, and have it for keeps?
Something to bring you joy,
When your heart is feeling weak?
But that taste can be bitter if the day when love goes south,
The sour of anger,
Broken hearts,
Angst in your mouth.

legendaryEditions.name: Taste LGD #5
legendaryEditions.description:
The taste of sea water,
The warmth of tea,
The sweet of maple syrup fresh dripped fresh from a tree,
The marmalade of summer,
The pumpkin pie of fall,
The cocoa of winter,
And the lemonade of spring
Just a few of life’s flavors,
That remind us,
That life is just beginning.

legendaryEditions.name: Taste LGD #6
legendaryEditions.description:
Taste is subjective.
Some like pepper,
Some like salt,
Some like sweet,
Some none of the above.
Some like wine,
Some like juice,
Some like garlic,
Some neither of the two,
I like my taste,
Because it’s mine.
Since you like yours,
We’ll get along just fine.

legendaryEditions.name: Taste LGD #7
legendaryEditions.description:
Nine thousand taste buds send signals to the mind,
The mind interprets what our taste will find.
These signals they vary depending where on the tongue
Nine thousand taste buds when we are young
Explosion of flavor,
Explosion of youth!
How sweet life is,
When life is a sweet tooth.

legendaryEditions.name: Taste LGD #8
legendaryEditions.description:
We often describe moments through taste.
The sweet taste of success,
The sour taste of loss.
The bitter taste of jealousy,
The delicate taste of love.
We know our tastes so well,
We attach them to things that have none.
Familiar.

legendaryEditions.name: Taste LGD #9
legendaryEditions.description:
Some candy is bittersweet-
And that’s a good thing,

But when life is bittersweet it’s not a happy ending,
How is one good?
And another full of pain?
I’m just a poet.
I’ll leave that to you to explain.

legendaryEditions.name: Taste LGD #10
legendaryEditions.description:
The taste of a lover does more than last.
It imprints a memory that aches when you fast.
Fast from their salt,
Fast from their wet,
Fast from their cologne,
Until your tongue can reset.
But your mind won’t forget the taste on your tongue.
Your thoughts might miss their air in your lung.
Long after the taste the mind makes it last,
Until you forget it all,
And taste brand new,
At last.

legendaryEditions.name: Touch LGD #1
legendaryEditions.description:
Your hands on my skin make me feel whole.
The gentle graze of your skin,
Awakens my soul,
The soft wet of your mouth arouses me wet.
Touch me again,
Help me never forget.

legendaryEditions.name: Touch LGD #2
legendaryEditions.description:
Blind men use touch,
And read without eyes,
There are three thousand receptors that don’t let hands lie.
These receptors reply to pressure of touch,
Packed under the surface of the skin,
To tell the brain what is enough.
Enough to tell,
Enough to lie,
A blind man will catch you with the touch without an eye.
See the eyes often times can deceive what is real,
Use the pressure points of touch,
If their eyes cheat and steal.

legendaryEditions.name: Touch LGD #3
legendaryEditions.description:
Now I sob,
Emotional hurt,
Now I’m sore because of your words.
Now I ache from your decisions pain.
The feelings of actions,
The weight of lifes remains,
Living with me,
And my bed is unkept.
I’ve been cross eyed with pain,
Long before you left.

legendaryEditions.name: Touch LGD #4
legendaryEditions.description:
A Mothers hand,
A graze that soothes,
Running water,
Golden sun,
And a bronzing mood,
A whisper ear,
A note of grace,
Calm my heart.
While I palpitate in place.

legendaryEditions.name: Touch LGD #5
legendaryEditions.description:
Finger tips,
Toes,
Cheeks and lips,
Elbows and knees,
Ears and hips.
Heels and private parts,
A gentle nudge,
A push or a wrestle,
The parts of the body,
That make touch so damn special.

legendaryEditions.name: Touch LGD #6
legendaryEditions.description:
There’s a burn that comes with a heart break.
Not a physical burn,
An emotional burn that your heart can’t take.
Feeling can be internal or external to the touch.
We can also be touched inside for loving too much.
We protect that place as we grow older,
To save us from the pain of being pushed over.
But the reward of a loving touch is far too great,
To live in fear everyday of a speculative fate.
So we take the pain and feel again,
Knowing that the touch of love,
Is always a win.

legendaryEditions.name: Touch LGD #7
legendaryEditions.description:
I feel you drip,
In my hand.
I feel you kiss,
Shake where you stand.
You feel me shake,
I grow and stand.
I press your wetness in my hand.
You feel my mouth,
Kiss and drip.
I feel your breath on my lips.
I’m home alone,
I feel you still,
Lingering moments,
I’ll forever feel.

legendaryEditions.name: Touch LGD #8
legendaryEditions.description:
Bubble wrap,
Warm Soup,
Smooth Silk,
Cold brew.
Soft fur,
A pets nose,
Warm sand,
And comfy winter clothes.
All things that are comfy every time to the touch,
The little things that remind us,
That life is enough.

legendaryEditions.name: Touch LGD #9
legendaryEditions.description:
A tickle can be pleasant.
Or overbearing,
A graze of a fingertip is good from someone caring.
A graze from a stranger can make you uneasy.
The touch of a lover can relax you and have meaning.
A touch from a ex can rouse up resentment.
A poke from a partner can bring laughs and comfortable presence.
Touches have different meanings depending on the delivery,
Fascinating how the same thing can be comforting or discomforting,
Context.

legendaryEditions.name: Touch LGD #10
legendaryEditions.description:
I am awakened when we touch,
Weak and feeble,
Your energy pulses through our electricity collides,
I am alive.
I react to your moves,
Run your tongue on my chest,
Breath on my neck,
Feel my spit -- Feel me whole.
I collapse on myself,
I discovered my soul.
